[[Hidesplitter's Shield]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[shield]] obtained from [[Hidesplitter's Chest]], which spawns after defeating [[Rragar Maneater]] in [[Rragar's Menagerie]].

==Stats==
:[[Armor rating|Armor]]: 16 (Requires 9 [[Tactics]])
:Received [[Physical damage]] -2 (while [[Enchantment spell|Enchanted]])
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as a [[Plated Shield]], [[dye]]d gray. <!-- Plated_Shield_dye_chart.jpg lacks grey dye, and the color of this shield does not suit to any of the dye chart's colors, hence its probably gray dye -->
